description: This file contains unit tests for the send algorithm in QUIC congestion control, simulating various network conditions and congestion control algorithms.

classes.name: SendAlgorithmTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for simulating and testing different congestion control algorithms and network conditions in QUIC.

methods.name: CreateSetup
methods.description: Sets up a simulated network environment with specified bandwidth, delay, and queue length.

methods.name: DoSimpleTransfer
methods.description: Performs a simple data transfer and verifies completion within a deadline.

methods.name: SendBursts
methods.description: Sends multiple data bursts with specified wait times and verifies transfer completion.

methods.name: EstimatedElapsedTime
methods.description: Estimates transfer time based on bandwidth and delay.

methods.name: QuicSenderStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the QUIC sender connection.

methods.name: PrintTransferStats
methods.description: Logs statistics about the transfer, including retransmission rate and elapsed time.
